description.text: Objectives The international undergraduate program in Art Design provides basic theory and technical knowledge of visual design, digital media design and industrial design to candidates who wish to work, teach, and do research in areas of art design. Students are expected to understand the challenges of modern art and industrial design, be able to independently create innovative designs. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years, with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A Bachelor of Art is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Color Composition, Graphic Composition, History of Chinese and Western Design, History of Modern Design, Design Psychology, Computer Aided Design, Visual Identification System Design, Interactive Media Design, Brand Planning Research. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Art Design at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
